title: Bug Hunt missing tenant filter
objectives: A correct SQL query can be an authorization vulnerability if it omits the tenant boundary. The result set needs an explicit positive and negative tenant assertion.
The tenant predicate reduces the result set before data is returned. The tests insist on known allowed rows and explicit exclusion of cross-tenant rows.
securityBoundary: A hardcoded tenant in a fixture does not enforce authorization in a web app. Production code must bind a verified request tenant, enforce object-level authorization, and preferably add database RLS with independently tested roles.
